evidence.activity: Sells Creative Cloud Pro, a subscription suite of apps for photography, design and video that people use to make creative work
evidence.quote: Adobe Creative Cloud Pro is a cloud-based subscription to an ecosystem of apps that enables creative professionals and enthusiasts alike to express themselves and collaborate with apps and services for photography, design, video, social media, and more
evidence.section: Item 1 > Principal Solutions > Creative & Marketing Professionals > Adobe Creative Cloud Pro

themes.creativity: enables others' creative work through creative software; flagship product line

evidence.activity: Digital Media reportable segment built around creative and productivity apps (Creative Cloud, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, Express)
evidence.quote: Digital Media. To serve the productivity and creativity needs of business professionals, consumers, creators and creative professionals, our Digital Media solutions include our Adobe Acrobat solutions, Adobe Express and our Creative Cloud subscriptions and flagship apps
evidence.indicators: reported segment; segment revenue not disclosed in provided text

themes.creativity: enabling creative work is a reported segment and the center of the company's stated mission

evidence.activity: Digital Media customers include artists, independent creators, solopreneurs and small business owners
evidence.quote: Our customers span creative professionals, including graphic designers, photographers, videographers, illustrators and 3D artists; creators, including social media influencers and solopreneurs; business professionals, including social media teams, small business owners and knowledge workers; and consumers.
evidence.section: Item 7 (targeted MD&A excerpts) > Digital Media segment description

themes.creativity: customer group is creative professionals and artists using the company's tools
themes.entrepreneurship: serves solopreneurs and small business owners as customers; no specific enabling program described

evidence.activity: Adobe Express, an easy content-creation app for novice creators
evidence.quote: Adobe Express is our all-in-one AI content creation app for users of any level, such as novice content creators and communicators, to easily create video, marketing, and social content.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Principal Solutions > Business Professionals & Consumers > Adobe Express

evidence.activity: Learning Fund that pays employees toward university and short-term learning
evidence.quote: Through Adobe’s Learning Fund, employees are eligible to receive up to $11,000 per year toward university and short-term learning opportunities.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital > Growth and Development
evidence.indicators: up to $11,000 per employee per year; 31,360 employees

evidence.activity: Free online self-service learning and fee-based training and certifications for customers and partners on Adobe products
evidence.quote: Our training portfolio includes a large number of free online self-service learning options on learning.adobe.com.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Operations > Services and Support > Digital Learning Solutions

themes.community: external education, limited in scale; it is product training for customers and partners, so it sits close to the 'educating customers' trap

evidence.activity: Adobe Research works with universities around the world
evidence.quote: In collaboration with universities around the world, the Adobe Research team of scientists, engineers, artists and designers are inventing the future of creativity, productivity and customer experiences.

themes.community: partnership with universities, limited reach and no figures

evidence.activity: Employee Networks and community-building events for staff
evidence.quote: We also strive to build community by bringing together our employees through onsite events, discussion groups, messaging forums and our Employee Networks as we believe that a sense of belonging contributes to our employees’ overall wellbeing.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital > Compensation, Benefits and Wellbeing

themes.cross_cultural: internal practice: employee networks with no membership figures

evidence.activity: Corporate venture capital program investing in outside companies
evidence.quote: Through our corporate venture capital program, Adobe Ventures, we invest in companies that are shaping the future of creativity, productivity, marketing and AI.

themes.entrepreneurship: described as strategic investing that serves Adobe's own strategy, not as a program that lowers barriers for founders

creativity.reason: Level 5: enabling others' creative work through creative software (Creative Cloud, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, Express) is the core business and the stated mission, centered in the Digital Media segment.

community.reason: Level 2: employee development of disclosed size (Learning Fund) plus limited, unmeasured external education and university research collaboration, with no community investment program or figures disclosed.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: a specific current internal practice (Employee Networks) with no figures; 'Adobe for All' is a belief statement and adds nothing beyond 1.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: the company serves solopreneurs and small business owners as customers but describes no specific program that enables founders, and Adobe Ventures is framed as strategic investing (held at the lower level when torn).

ai.notes: Community and Cross-cultural coverage marked insufficient: the Human Capital section covers employee pay, benefits and development but says nothing about external community programs, accessibility or inclusion practices beyond the 'Adobe for All' belief statement and a passing mention of Employee Networks. Both themes should get the automated second look using the sustainability report. Item 7 lists 'charitable contributions' only as a G&A expense line, with no program or amount, so it was not scored. Adobe Commerce (an enterprise e-commerce platform) was not counted as an affordable merchant tool, because the filing describes no small-business or founder focus. 'Accessible entry points' in the freemium language means low-cost access, not disability accessibility, so it was not counted for Cross-cultural. 'State of the art' in the R&D section is a trap phrase and was not counted. 'Training' of Firefly AI models is a trap use of the word and was not counted for Community. Publishing and Advertising includes legacy eLearning solutions, but no detail is given, so they were not scored. Segments will be combined into one segment from Q1 fiscal 2026; this does not affect the fiscal 2025 scores.
